From sketch to store

  1. Design

    Flows and screens worked out first, in both languages when the product needs it, so building starts from decisions rather than guesses.

  2. Build

    Front end, API and database, tested and documented so another developer can pick it up.

  3. Ship

    Deployed to the web or packaged for Android and iOS, with a link you can open on day one.
